title: Gary Nolan's CIA file on UFO experiencers and Havana syndrome

tellings.quote: And I remember talking to Gary Nolan and he mentioned that he was kind of given a file by the CIA and he was tasked with looking into this.

plain: A scientist named Garry Nolan was reportedly handed a file by the CIA and asked to look into people who had been injured, including UFO witnesses and victims of Havana syndrome, the mysterious illnesses reported by US diplomats and officials. Michels tells this from his own conversation with Nolan, who he says mentioned being "given a file by the CIA" and "tasked with looking into this."
